policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA conforming loan limit for next year — expected late November
policy_calendar.note: The cap on a conforming (non-jumbo) mortgage, and the line between a normal rate and a jumbo one. FHFA has announced it in the last days of November each year, and the new limit applies to loans made from January 1.

tech.summary: Concerns are emerging regarding Nvidia's sale of H200 AI chips to Chinese firms, including one with an empty office, raising questions about due diligence by the Commerce Department and Nvidia.

The global music body IFPI has warned the Australian government that weakening AI copyright law would be a "disaster for creativity" and damage Australia's reputation, arguing against allowing AI companies access to online content.
Meta's Chief Strategy Officer, Dave Wehner, has departed to become the CFO of Fireworks, an AI infrastructure startup recently valued at $17.5 billion.

world.summary: Israel's president has selected Gadi Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar party and a rival to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, to attempt to form a new government after a deadlocked election.

A US task force has been established with the goal of disrupting Iran's transport of advanced weapons, though analysts express skepticism about its full success in completely choking off supply lines.
Russian strikes have caused widespread power outages in Ukraine, leaving approximately 850,000 people without electricity in the Dnipropetrovsk and Kharkiv regions.
At least 21 people died when a small migrant boat sank off the coast of Senegal, with a search operation underway after one person was rescued.

us.summary: Homelessness in the U.S. has decreased for the second consecutive year, marking the largest drop in over a decade, according to recent analyses.
Democrats plan to broaden investigations into fatal Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) shootings, particularly those that occurred during a surge in Minneapolis.

The Trump administration's proposed changes to the National Historic Preservation Act have drawn concern from Oklahoma tribes, who state that ancestral lands in Ohio and other historic sites across the country are at risk.

science.summary: Climate change is causing shifts in the natural colors observed across various environments, from Arctic landscapes to the bodies of insects.
An experimental drug designed to lower a common risk factor for heart attacks unexpectedly failed to demonstrate any benefit in saving patients' lives.

weekly_recap: The past week brought market volatility, with initial stock index drops fueled by AI spending fears, followed by US market gains attributed to midterm election results. Globally, however, some markets experienced sell-offs. Key developments included widespread cyberattacks on European supermarkets and a growing debate over AI funding and copyright. Politically, Democrats gained full control of the US Congress, while Israel began the process of forming a new government. Looking ahead, the Cop31 climate summit is set to commence, New Zealand faces weeks of coalition negotiations, and US Democrats are expected to focus on investigations into ICE shootings and potential changes to tariffs.
